meta.title: Press — Johan Nilsson
meta.description: A podcast on investing in fitness and the trade press in Sweden, Norway, Spain and Switzerland on Johan Nilsson and Barry’s.

sections.label: On the record

img.alt: A studio lounge in low light (provisional art direction)

sections.sub: A podcast on investing in fitness, and the trade press in Sweden, Norway, Spain and Switzerland on each market opened.

items.t: Barry’s erobert Zürich: the first Barry’s in Switzerland
items.a: Fitness Tribune, interview with Julia Röthlisberger
items.v: How a Zürich founder found her business partner on Instagram and had an answer three hours later; the opening in November 2025; Geneva next.
items.why: “He has enormous experience and has helped build Barry’s studios in several regions of the world.” Translated from German.

items.t: Zürich: Fitnesskette Barry’s eröffnet erste Schweizer Filiale
items.v: The announcement of the first Swiss studio, in Zürich’s Kreis 1.

items.t: Årsrapport 2022: Så gick det för Barry’s i Sverige
items.v: The Swedish company’s 2022 accounts: two studios in Sweden, with Johan Nilsson as CEO.

items.t: La cadena de boutiques Barry’s aterriza en España con un club en Madrid
items.v: The licence for Spain, held with José Daniel García and Kevin Triguero; the first club in Madrid’s Salamanca district.
items.why: Named as managing director of the company in the Nordic countries.

items.t: Barry’s-franchisetagarna i Norden slås ihop och bildar regionens största boutiqueaktör
items.v: Eight studios, around 250 people, a revenue target of SEK 100 million for 2022 and a plan for sixteen studios in the Nordics.
items.why: “I am proud and expectant to announce this merger.” Translated from Swedish.

items.t: Barry’s skaper Nordens største aktør innen boutique fitness
items.v: The Norwegian trade press on the merger of the Swedish and Norwegian companies.

items.t: Johan Nilsson — investerare & VD Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic
items.v: An hour on strategy in the fitness sector, what he looks at when assessing a potential investment, and Barry’s progress in the Nordics.
items.why: Investments named through Stockholm Leisure Partners: Playbook App, ClassPass Nordics, REPEAT Fitness and Challengize.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Begin <t>a conversation.</t>
sections.lede: How people reach Johan is his decision. On the finished platform this becomes a short enquiry, routed by subject; here it is shown as it would work, and it is not switched on.

steps.d: The subjects, and how they are worded, are agreed with Johan before launch.
Read by Johan or his office. Nothing confidential is asked for at first contact.
What is welcome, and how quickly, stays his decision. The platform only makes the first step clear.

demo.note: Nothing on this preview sends a message or collects information.

igy.label: A concept by
igy.note: A concept prepared by Ignite Yourself from public sources, his LinkedIn profile and the trade press, for Johan Nilsson’s review. It is not his official website and has not been reviewed or approved by him. Portraits and studio scenes are AI-generated art direction based on public photographs; they do not record real events or places. Copy, figures and photography remain subject to his validation. The page is excluded from search engines.
